## ABOUT
My name is Rimjhim Saxena (Pronounced : *Rim-Jim Sax-éna*). I am a **Researcher at the Institute of Economics and Econometrics (IEE) at the Geneva School of Economics and Management (GSEM) at the University of Geneva, Switzerland**. I graduated with my PhD in Economics from the [University of Colorado, Boulder](https://www.colorado.edu/economics/) in May 2025. I like working at the intersection of Climate + Labor + Development, preferably with a good coffee.

### Upcoming whereabouts:

1. [Paris Environmental Economics Workshop](https://www.parisschoolofeconomics.eu/en/events/paris-environmental-economics-workshop/) - April 7-8, 2026, Paris, France
2.  [2026 International Energy Workshop](https://www.internationalenergyworkshop.org/meetings/iew-2026/) - June 22-24, 2026, Cape Town, South Africa
3.  [European Association for Labour Economics (EALE) 2026](https://www.ub.edu/eale2026/) - Aug 31-Sept 2, 2026, Barcelona, Spain
